title: Borrower Terms for the Interest Rate Buydown: Cancellation and Changes Before Closing
content:
**Interest Rate Buydown — terms for the borrower.**

1. *Cancellation fee and window.* For every product of the Interest Rate Buydown the fee to cancel before closing is $0.00, and the last point at which the buydown can be cancelled is consummation.
2. *Who cancels, and from which status.* The borrower may drop the buydown while it is elected (before approval) or approved (before consummation); the buydown is then cancelled. A buydown that is elected or approved is also cancelled when the loan file is withdrawn or denied. A cancelled buydown records the date it was cancelled.
3. *Changes of note rate or loan amount.* For every product, a change of note rate or loan amount recomputes the subsidy or points cost.

| Product | Fee to cancel before closing | Last point at which it can be cancelled | A change of note rate or loan amount recomputes the subsidy or points cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 1-0 Temporary Buydown | $0.00 | consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur 1-1 Temporary Buydown | $0.00 | consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown | $0.00 | consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur 3-2-1 Temporary Buydown | $0.00 | consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur One-Point Permanent Buydown | $0.00 | consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown | $0.00 | consummation | Yes |
| Larkspur Three-Point Permanent Buydown | $0.00 | consummation | Yes |

### Status and outcome

| Buydown status | Borrower drops the buydown | Loan file withdrawn or denied |
|---|---|---|
| elected | cancelled, fee $0.00 | cancelled |
| approved | cancelled, fee $0.00 | cancelled |

A funded buydown has passed consummation, the last point at which a buydown can be cancelled.

### Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A borrower drops an approved Larkspur 2-1 Temporary Buydown the week before consummation: the buydown is cancelled and the fee is $0.00.
- The note rate on a file with an elected Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown moves before consummation: the points cost is recomputed.
